title: Witcher Fallout Auction
description: A dramatic fantasy auction hall scene with purple and golden magical clouds, lightning, and dripping light effects on the ceiling. Geralt of Rivia in black armor with a red cape stands beside a glowing display pedestal showing a detailed miniature city model, while a long table holds numerous fantasy and sci-fi collectibles behind velvet ropes.
prompt: Ornate baroque auction house interior with velvet ropes and red seating, magical purple storm clouds with lightning and glowing purple SOLD sign floating in the air, golden clouds dripping light from the ceiling, Geralt of Rivia with long white hair wearing black armor and flowing red cape standing next to a pedestal displaying a futuristic miniature city model, long display table with various fantasy figurines and artifacts, glowing blue sign reading WITCHER MISSION IMPOSSIBLE FALLOUT, elegant cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere
